freeze_rule: Only races whose official post time is on or after first_eligible_post count. Everything before (11/13-16, 116 PAPER races / 5 formal races) is research replay used to form the hypotheses, never OOS.
production_change: NONE. Candidates are evaluated in shadow only; promotion needs a separate explicit Owner approval after the promotion criteria hold.

candidates.hypothesis: 3連複 1番人気軸 × PAPER上位4頭流し (6点) beats the PAPER Champion tickets on PFS with less stake.
candidates.scope: all LOCAL PAPER races with a settled result
candidates.champion: PAPER_実買い目 (frozen 直前版 tickets)
candidates.population: same races, same frozen revision, same payouts
secondary_metrics: share of payout from the top 1 race
candidates.reject_if: at 100R the 95% bootstrap CI of the PFS difference is entirely below 0, or candidate PFS < 80%
candidates.promote_if: at 100R the 95% CI of the PFS difference is above 0 and the top-1 race supplies < 40% of candidate payout; re-confirm at 300R

candidates.hypothesis: 1番人気 with 危険度ランクA (Drive 地方競馬版・危険な1番人気 第9章) wins at least 10 points less often than 1番人気 with rank NONE.
candidates.population: same days, rank A vs rank NONE favorites
secondary_metrics: 2番人気 WIN PFS when the favorite is rank A
candidates.promote_if: at 100R the difference >= 10 points with >= 30 rank-A races; then propose to the Owner as a W-role caution input

candidates.hypothesis: When ◎ != 1番人気, the 1番人気 wins more often than ◎ (win rate difference >= 15 points).
candidates.promote_if: at 100R the difference >= 15 points and WIN PFS of 1番人気 >= ◎; then propose to the Owner a review of the PAPER W selection

candidates.hypothesis: The R54 60-point cap (already adopted) does not lower PFS versus the full signed MEC set.
candidates.change: none (measures the adopted cap); adoption is not proof of advantage
candidates.scope: formal races with LIVE_R54 cap evaluation
candidates.champion: full Signed FINAL MEC R3 set (settled by the Runtime signed RESULT)
candidates.reject_if: at 100R the capped PFS is lower by more than 10 points (report to the Owner; no automatic change)
candidates.promote_if: not applicable (already Production); report the measured effect
